_comment: Ground truth for local runs: what is actually on the road, and when.
Both the fixture cameras and the scripted vision analyzer read this file.
The cameras draw what it says; the analyzer reports what it says, degraded
by lighting and a little noise. Nothing here short-circuits the pipeline --
the gate still has to confirm hazards across two frames, the jurisdiction
rules still have to find the right agency, and the Auditor still has to
Times are minutes from the run's start instant, which `make demo` pins to
Thursday 2026-07-30 07:00 UTC. That reproduces the nine cases from the
design comps at their original days and times.
Cameras absent from this file have clear roads. They matter: they are what
the perceptual-hash diffing and the prefilter get to throw away, and they
are where the analyzer's occasional false positives show up and die at the

scenarios._case: NC-1171 — a signal that looks like the state's problem and isn't
scenarios.description: Signal head visibly rotated out of alignment, facing away from oncoming traffic.
scenarios.note: Exercises the municipal-signal rule: US route, but a city-owned signal inside Durham.

scenarios._case: FL-2198 — the Turnpike clears its own mess, fast
scenarios.description: Large soft object, consistent with a mattress, spanning two travel lanes.
scenarios.note: Toll authority, not FDOT D5. Clears in 2h51m, producing a before/after pair.

scenarios._case: GA-4465 — pre-dawn, grainy, not worth waking anyone for
scenarios.description: Something animal-shaped on the northbound shoulder. Heavy grain, pre-dawn light.
scenarios.note: Night penalty drags confidence under the bar. Should watch, never file.

scenarios._case: FL-2204 — detected cleanly, then deliberately dropped
scenarios.description: Right lane coned off with no advance warning signage visible upstream.
scenarios.official_event_description: Right lane closed for maintenance, I-95 southbound at Atlantic Blvd
scenarios.note: Florida already posted this 210m up the road. Must suppress -- the whole point is catching what they missed.

scenarios._case: NC-1176 — nobody's emergency, which is why it would have sat for months
scenarios.description: Guardrail torn open in the median, rail end protruding toward the travel lanes.
scenarios.note: Long SLA (two weeks). Stays 'filed' rather than escalating during a one-week demo.

scenarios._case: NC-1180 — the one nobody comes for
scenarios.description: Standing water across the shoulder and encroaching on the right travel lane.
scenarios.note: 6h SLA, never clears. This is the escalation path: tier 2 at 6h, human flag at 12h.

scenarios._case: FL-2209 — one frame is a maybe, not a yes
scenarios.description: A vehicle stopped on the right shoulder. No hazard lights visible, no occupants outside.
scenarios.note: Cars pull over for ordinary reasons. Sits below the filing bar and clears on its own.

scenarios.description: Large dark object, likely shed truck tire tread, in the center travel lane. Two vehicles observed making lateral deviations to avoid it.
scenarios.note: Files cleanly, then stays put -- so it is still being chased when the demo ends.

scenarios._case: GA-4468 — filed Monday, gone by Tuesday
scenarios.description: Shed tire tread in the left travel lane, partially in the shadow of the overpass.
scenarios.note: The success story: closes with a genuine before/after pair from the same camera.

scenarios._case: extra — a second flooding event so escalation is not a single sample
scenarios.description: Water sheeting across the eastbound lanes on the Black Mountain grade.
scenarios.note: Files and then clears inside its 6h window -- a normal, boring success.

scenarios._case: extra — a stall that resolves before it is ever confirmed
scenarios.description: Vehicle stopped on the bridge shoulder.
scenarios.note: Gone within an hour. Should never reach a filing -- it fails the persistence check.

scenarios._case: extra — pedestrian on the interstate, the shortest fuse in the system
scenarios.description: A person on foot on the inside shoulder at Spaghetti Junction.
scenarios.note: Critical severity clears a lower confidence bar on purpose -- 1h SLA.
